# orders-service runbook

## Rollbacks

To roll back, redeploy the previous tag from CI. Database migrations are not rolled back automatically; write a new migration instead.

## On call

The on-call engineer is paged for failed health checks. Check the #orders-alerts channel before making changes on staging.

## Logs

Service logs are in journald. Use `make logs` for the last deploy and `journalctl -u orders` for the service. Logs are kept for 14 days.

## Deploys

Deploys run from CI on every merge to main. The deploy job builds the image, applies database migrations and restarts the service. Schema errors after a deploy are fixed by running `make db-reset`. A deploy takes about four minutes.

## Integration tests

Integration tests run against the staging database after every deploy. Staging is shared with the QA team, who keep their manual test accounts and orders there. Results go to #orders-alerts.
